logger.doc:name: Start Logger
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "flowName": flow.name, "timestamp": now() >> "UTC", "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "status": "Received request to update employee records by empid" }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var employee = (payload filter (item) -> item.empId == vars.emp_id)[0] --- { first_name: employee.firstName default null, last_name: employee.lastName default null, email_id: employee.emailId default null, date_of_joining: employee.dateOfJoining default null, address: employee.address default null, emp_id: employee.empId }

db:bulk-update.doc:name: Bulk Update using Database Connector
db:bulk-update.db:sql: UPDATE first_project.employee SET first_name = COALESCE(:first_name, first_name), last_name = COALESCE(:last_name, last_name), email_id = COALESCE(:email_id, email_id), date_of_joining = COALESCE(:date_of_joining, date_of_joining), address = COALESCE(:address, address) WHERE emp_id = :emp_id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "Success", message: "Employee record Updated successfully" }

logger.doc:name: Response Logger
logger.message:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "flowName": flow.name, "timestamp": now() >> "UTC", "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "status": payload,
}]
